meta.title: Therapia Global — Clinical video library
meta.description: 439 physiotherapy and osteopathy techniques with video and anatomical view, patient routines via WhatsApp and clinical records. In 10 languages.

landing.headline:
Your physiotherapy practice
in one place
landing.subheadline: 439 exercise, stretching and osteopathy techniques with video and anatomical view. Build routines in minutes and send them to your patients via WhatsApp.

routines.title: Routine builder
routines.desc: Pick exercises, set sets and reps, add notes and send the link to your patient.

library.title: Video library
library.desc: Strengthening, stretching and osteopathy by region, searchable by name or muscle.

osteopathy.title: Osteopathy techniques
osteopathy.desc: 94 structural, visceral and cranial techniques with video.

anatomy.title: Anatomical view
anatomy.desc: Each technique shows the muscles that work and those that stretch, with their names.

tracking.title: Patient Tracking
tracking.desc: Monitor exercise adherence in real time. Automatic alerts for low adherence.

ai.title: Clinical AI
ai.desc: AI suggests optimized routines based on diagnosis, region and patient profile. Trained on millions of clinical cases.

clinical.title: Clinical records
clinical.desc: Patients and SOAP notes stored in your account, visible only to you.

whatsapp.title: No app for the patient
whatsapp.desc: Patients open their routine from WhatsApp or email, in their language, with video and a rest timer.

landing.footer_cta: Try Therapia Global with your patients
